SMS Spam Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques \n Sulaimani Polytechnic University \n College of Informatics

This application is a demo version, based on the thesis project under the name of "SMS Spam Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques". It is created and designed by Msc Student Diyari Jalal Mussa \nand Supervised by Dr. Noor Ghazi. \n The Main intention of this android app is to show how gradient boosting machine learning algorithm can detect the Spam messages and filter them in special folder by analysing the messages features which can be obtained through the content of the text message.
